nodes.label: Statement 7: Clozapine for Treatment-Resistant Schizophrenia
nodes.rationale: A substantial fraction of nonresponders respond to clozapine; with ANC and side-effect monitoring, benefits far outweigh harms given the morbidity of untreated resistant illness.

nodes.label: Clozapine Initiation, Titration, and REMS-Guided Monitoring
nodes.rationale: Slow titration to typically 300-450 mg/day with ANC monitoring, side-effect surveillance, and plasma-level checks; restart at 12.5 mg after gaps; taper on discontinuation.

nodes.label: Treatment-Resistant Schizophrenia per TRRIP Criteria
nodes.rationale: Defined by persistent significant symptoms despite adequate pharmacological trials; clozapine is underused and should be considered earlier, including partial responders.
